nodes.name: test_remote_proxy.py
nodes.summary: Tests the admin web server proxy to a remote VPS using httpx mock transport: token substitution, login requirement, blocked sensitive paths, 401/502 handling, and refusal of plain-http remote URLs.

nodes.name: test_roles.py
nodes.summary: Tests role resolution (owner, leader, basic) per group and chat type, including the ASSIGN_ALLOWED setting and required-role permission checks.

nodes.name: test_schedule_tool.py
nodes.summary: Tests the schedule web tools against a mocked agent API: base URL normalization, registration only with an API key, bearer auth, event/task creation, and error passthrough to the model.

nodes.name: test_storage.py
nodes.summary: Tests the persistence layer: JSONL/object file recovery, UTF-8 and surrogate handling, group/seen/history/usage stores, instance locking, and group leader/team records.

nodes.name: test_text_and_models.py
nodes.summary: Tests message splitting by UTF-16 length, plain-text conversion, owner command parsing, Zalo update parsing, and dedupe key stability.

nodes.name: test_updater.py
nodes.summary: Tests the git-based auto-updater using local bare/clone repos: pending update detection, pulling commits, local-change conflicts, and unavailability for exe or non-git installs.

nodes.name: test_vps_supervisor.py
nodes.summary: Tests VPS process supervision: BOT_SUPERVISOR validation, standby mode, systemd start/stop via sudo, failure reporting, and secret-free server info API.

nodes.name: _example.py
nodes.summary: Example plugin tool (skipped by the loader due to leading underscore) showing how to register a current_time tool returning Vietnam time.

nodes.name: SYSTEM.md
nodes.summary: System prompt for the Zalo assistant in Vietnamese: role, plain-text reply style, brevity, prompt-injection resistance, and refusal of harmful requests.
